“How should I know?” Ignacio demanded, blinking at the object of interest. “Only now have I awakened.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u007-r0035", "tag": "p", "text": "“You have not been paid to be honest, then?” Rafael asked.", "sha256": "0ef3fdf6d7bdbba46262b7ad2d088c08846a91ffff89c8c506895ee2c74a2bd9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[519]", "source_html": "

“You have not been paid to be honest, then?” Rafael asked.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u007-r0036", "tag": "p", "text": "“Merciful Mother of God, who is the man who would pay me to be honest?” the turnkey demanded.", "sha256": "f0bd248b7404180c90b6b567ad6c7dada051b0ec0db6d22d617224f49a4ab129", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[520]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u007-r0042", "tag": "p", "text": "“How excellently is it composed,” Pedro murmured in tones of awe. “It must be very good that such care be taken of it.”", "sha256": "8722d7d1cd6755bab1601ab1aee08e7705406222f3f36c1b785289234c58a79b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[526]", "source_html": "

“How excellently is it composed,” Pedro murmured in tones of awe. “It must be very good that such care be taken of it.”

It is true, the bull rolled me, but did I not leap into the ring?”", "sha256": "7224b5ad60d9195dba035eecbab5fd28d4175a117d8901a73752616583e834fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[527]", "source_html": "
